dedupe_keys.name: ercot market information grid and market conditions data access portal and day ahead and real time price reports texas

description: The Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) publishes its market information through several channels. Grid and Market Conditions is a set of dashboards on current grid and market conditions; the ERCOT Market Information List (EMIL) is a searchable list of every market product that its Protocols and other binding documents require it to publish; and the Data Access Portal searches ERCOT public data. The market information page also links day-ahead and real-time displays and reports: settlement point prices, real-time locational marginal prices by electrical bus, resource node, load zone and trading hub, clearing prices for capacity (ancillary services), and day-ahead market results such as shadow prices, energy bought and sold and aggregated ancillary service offer curves. Coverage: the ERCOT region of Texas. Format and access: web displays and downloadable reports; free. Licence: not stated on the page read; terms of use were not read. Caveats: only the market information index was read, so file formats, history and API access were not checked. Simulation uses: prices, demand and grid conditions for capacity planning, optimisation and studies of stressed grid conditions. Related records: the gridstatus library (data-gridstatus) retrieves ERCOT data programmatically.
